pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take:
**Mustard Boy, your yellow streak is showing.**

Zach, look at me. BRAZIL as your Tier 1 team? Sure, you suckered yourself into thinking they would cruise through, but let's talk about Ghana—your precious Ghana—falling apart against Colombia like a lawn chair under a sumo wrestler. You couldn’t even squeeze out a point from them. Your roster screams “style over substance,” and I’ll bet my iconic facial hair that you'll mismanage them just like you did in 2018. You’ve got Brazil trying their samba against Switzerland’s yodeling, and if they slip, oh boy, the Mustard Boy might just become the Butter Boy.

Bubba G, it might look like you're sitting pretty with your 47 points, but let me remind you, you built those points on the softest of sands. France might be carrying your sorry draft picks like they’re the team’s oversized luggage, but DR Congo in Tier 4? Come on, my grandma wouldn’t even pick them. You've got the "kings of almost" Senegal gearing up for their next match in Houston. I'm calling it now: they'll choke harder than I did on my first iced cappuccino.

Ghost Pepper, Devin, my man, you flavorless genius. Spain and USA working together, it’s like putting ketchup on pasta—doesn’t make any sense, but here you are. You stared down Bosnia in your own Third Tier of Doom and thought "Yup, that's the ticket," and now you're riding second place like you just discovered seatbelts. If Spain doesn't rescue you soon, prepare to drop like me diving for that rogue soccer ball in 1994.

Backpass Assassin Gayden, you're stuck in a tactical nightmare that even England can't save you from. Japan and Korea Republic holding down the middle like they're at a stalemate conference—there's no flair, no fire, and definitely no future. You’ll march into Philly expecting something from your mismatched army of underdogs, but here's the twist: they're leading you nowhere. Mark my words, your roster is as misplaced as a vegan at a Texas barbecue.

Noisemaker Rafe, you're as loud as you are clueless, and I LOVE it. Germany might hold a glimmer of hope for you, but Tunisia and Uzbekistan should never have seen the light of this draft. Picking teams that didn’t qualify is the kind of chaotic genius your dad pretends doesn't run
